description: This file defines the PolicyTag class, representing the ID and revision of a Policy within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating PolicyTag instances from PolicyId and JSON, and encapsulates related properties.

classes.name: PolicyTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a Policy's ID and revision, with factory methods for instantiation from parameters or JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyTag instance with given PolicyId and revision.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyTag from a JSON object, extracting PolicyId and revision.
